messages.content: What is the historical significance of Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood?

**Why Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood matters:**  

• It’s one of Dubai’s oldest preserved districts, dating back to the **1890s** (From Excerpt 1).  
• The area originally held about **60 housing units**, linked by **narrow, winding lanes** that showcase traditional street patterns (From Excerpt 1).  
• It was **built by affluent Persian merchants** who came for Dubai’s booming trade and the incentives the Emirati offered (From Excerpt 1).  
• The neighborhood’s architecture and layout give a rare glimpse into Dubai’s **pre‑oil, merchant‑driven era** – a living museum of the city’s early multicultural roots.
